scope: Full Japanese context and all12 sentence/task sets; no native, metadata, device or release certification.

changes.before: একই বগি হলেও পাশের আসন নয়। বন্ধুর আসন নম্বরও দেখা যায় এমন কিছু আছে?
changes.after: একই বগি হলেও আসন পাশাপাশি হবে, এমন নিশ্চয়তা নেই। আপনার বন্ধুর আসন নম্বরও দেখা যায় এমন কিছু আছে?
changes.reason: Not necessarily adjacent must not become definitely not adjacent.

changes.before: डब्बा एउटै भए पनि छेउको सिट हुँदैन। साथीको सिट नम्बरसमेत देखिने केही छ?
changes.after: डब्बा एउटै भए पनि सिट छेउछेउमै हुन्छ भन्ने हुँदैन। साथीको सिट नम्बरसमेत देखिने केही छ?
changes.reason: Preserve lack of guarantee rather than categorical denial of adjacency.

changes.before: Chúng tôi nhận tư vấn vị trí hai người. Cho xem ảnh ở đây rồi cùng kiểm tra tàu và ghế ứng viên.
changes.after: Chúng tôi sẽ tiếp nhận yêu cầu tư vấn vị trí ghế của hai người. Anh/chị cho xem ảnh ở đây, rồi chúng ta cùng kiểm tra chuyến tàu và các lựa chọn ghế nhé.
changes.reason: Seat candidates are seating options, not human candidates.

changes.before: ภาพที่ส่งมีแต่เลขตู้ค่ะ ส่วนที่นั่งถูกตัด จะถามเพื่อนใหม่
changes.after: ภาพที่เพื่อนส่งมามีแต่เลขตู้ค่ะ ส่วนเลขที่นั่งถูกตัดออกไป ฉันจะถามรายละเอียดจากเพื่อนอีกครั้ง
changes.reason: Ask existing friend again, not a new friend.

changes.before: រូបផ្ញើមានតែលេខទូ។ ផ្នែកកៅអីកាត់បាត់ នឹងសួរមិត្តថ្មី។
changes.after: រូបដែលមិត្តផ្ញើមកមានតែលេខទូ។ ផ្នែកកៅអីត្រូវបានកាត់បាត់ ដូច្នេះខ្ញុំនឹងសួរមិត្តម្តងទៀត។
changes.reason: Ask friend again rather than a new friend.

changes.before: Kertas ini memuat nama orang asing. Pemberitahuan untuk saya, tetapi tidak tahu perlu menghapus dan mengganti nama sendiri atau tidak.
changes.after: Kertas ini memuat nama orang yang tidak saya kenal. Pemberitahuan ini ditujukan kepada saya, tetapi saya tidak tahu apakah nama itu harus dihapus dan diganti dengan nama saya sendiri.
changes.reason: Unknown person does not mean foreign national.

changes.before: មានក្រដាសសនេះ។ អ្នកមានឈ្មោះជាគំរូសរសេរ មិនមែនឱ្យចម្លងឈ្មោះគេទេមែនទេ?
changes.after: មានក្រដាសសនេះផង។ ក្រដាសដែលមានឈ្មោះជាគំរូបំពេញ មិនមែនសម្រាប់ឱ្យខ្ញុំចម្លងឈ្មោះមនុស្សនោះទេ មែនទេ?
changes.reason: Named item is sample sheet, not a named person being a writing sample.

changes.before: បង្ហាញទម្រង់ទទេ បញ្ជាក់អ្នកមានឈ្មោះជាគំរូ មិនមែនចម្លងឈ្មោះ។ និយាយជាភាសាជប៉ុន។
changes.after: បង្ហាញទម្រង់ទទេ ហើយបញ្ជាក់ថាក្រដាសដែលមានឈ្មោះជាគំរូបំពេញ មិនមែនឱ្យចម្លងឈ្មោះនោះទេ។ និយាយជាភាសាជប៉ុន។
changes.reason: Correct sheet/person referent in hint.

changes.before: Pertama di sini, tetapi pernah ke tempat lain untuk nyeri pergelangan sama. Menulis pertama terasa seperti kunjungan sebelumnya tidak ada.
changes.after: Ini pertama kali saya ke sini, tetapi saya sudah berobat di tempat lain untuk nyeri pada pergelangan tangan yang sama. Menulis ‘pertama kali’ terasa seolah kunjungan sebelumnya tidak pernah ada.
changes.reason: Specify wrist rather than ambiguous joint term also used for ankle.

changes.before: Sampaikan pertama di fasilitas ini tetapi sudah berobat untuk pergelangan sama di tempat lain, sehingga bingung kolom pertama. Sampaikan dalam bahasa Jepang.
changes.after: Sampaikan dalam bahasa Jepang bahwa ini pertama kali di fasilitas ini, tetapi Anda sudah berobat di tempat lain untuk pergelangan tangan yang sama, sehingga bingung mengisi kolom pertama kali.
changes.reason: Hint needs hand-wrist anatomy.

changes.before: Sekitar dua minggu lalu setelah membawa barang, saya menyadari pergelangan kanan sakit. Ke tempat lain minggu lalu, berbeda hari dari awal sakit.
changes.after: Sekitar dua minggu lalu, setelah membawa barang, saya menyadari pergelangan tangan kanan terasa nyeri. Saya pergi ke tempat lain minggu lalu, pada hari yang berbeda dari awal nyerinya.
changes.reason: Restore explicit right wrist and temporal relation without causal diagnosis.

changes.before: Jelaskan nyeri pergelangan kanan disadari setelah membawa barang dua minggu lalu, dan fasilitas lain dikunjungi minggu lalu. Sampaikan dalam bahasa Jepang.
changes.after: Jelaskan dalam bahasa Jepang bahwa nyeri pergelangan tangan kanan disadari setelah membawa barang sekitar dua minggu lalu, sedangkan kunjungan ke fasilitas lain dilakukan minggu lalu.
changes.reason: Specify right wrist and separate onset/visit dates.

changes.before: Lokasinya sama, pergelangan kanan, tetapi sulit mengatakan apakah keadaannya persis sama dengan pemeriksaan lalu. Ingin mengatakan terus terang tidak tahu.
changes.after: Lokasinya sama, yaitu pergelangan tangan kanan, tetapi saya sulit menjelaskan apakah kondisinya benar-benar sama dengan saat pemeriksaan sebelumnya. Saya ingin mengatakan terus terang bahwa saya tidak tahu.
changes.reason: Right wrist location must remain explicit.

changes.before: Lokasi pergelangan kanan sama tetapi sulit menyatakan keadaan sepenuhnya sama, ingin menyampaikan ketidaktahuan apa adanya. Sampaikan dalam bahasa Jepang.
changes.after: Sampaikan dalam bahasa Jepang bahwa lokasinya tetap pergelangan tangan kanan, tetapi sulit menjelaskan apakah kondisinya sepenuhnya sama dengan sebelumnya, sehingga Anda ingin menyatakan apa adanya bahwa Anda tidak tahu.
changes.reason: Maintain wrist anatomy and uncertainty in hint.

changes.before: Sa lupa matapos lampasan ang inuman mula sa pasukan. Saka ako sa bangko sa larawan kaya nahalo ang dalawang lugar.
changes.after: Nasa lupa ito, pagkalampas sa gripo ng inuming tubig mula sa pasukan. Pagkatapos ko itong mapulot, saka ako pumunta sa bangkong nasa larawan, kaya napaghalo ko ang dalawang lugar.
changes.reason: Inuman can mean drinking session/bar; source is park drinking-water point.

changes.before: Ipaliwanag ang pagkakapulot sa lupang lampas sa inuman mula sa pasukan, saka pagpunta sa bangko sa larawan. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.
changes.after: Ipaliwanag sa wikang Hapon na napulot mo ito sa lupa pagkalampas sa gripo ng inuming tubig mula sa pasukan, at pagkatapos ay pumunta ka sa bangkong nasa larawan.
changes.reason: Keep water-point landmark unambiguous in hint.

changes.before: Lampas sa inuman napulot, saka bangko. Eksaktong oras ng pagkapulot natatandaan?
changes.after: Napulot ninyo ito pagkalampas sa gripo ng inuming tubig, at saka nagpahinga sa bangko, tama? Naaalala ba ninyo ang eksaktong oras nang mapulot ito?
changes.reason: Specify water-point landmark and exact pickup-time question.

changes.before: Tôi ra nhà cũ nhưng ở chỗ tạm đến khi vào nhà mới. Biết địa chỉ mới nên muốn hỏi gửi thư đến ngay.
changes.after: Tôi đã rời nhà cũ nhưng đang ở chỗ trọ tạm trong lúc chờ vào nhà mới. Vì đã biết địa chỉ nhà mới, tôi muốn hỏi về việc gửi thư đến đó ngay.
changes.reason: Natural expression for already leaving old residence; retain current temporary lodging.

changes.before: চাবি পাইনি। আগামী মাসে উঠব, তার আগে ডাক নেওয়া যাবে কি না জিজ্ঞেস করিনি।
changes.after: আমি এখনও চাবি পাইনি। আগামী মাসে ওঠার পরিকল্পনা আছে, আর তার আগে সেখানে ডাক গ্রহণ করা যাবে কি না জিজ্ঞেস করিনি।
changes.reason: Move-in next month is planned, not a confirmed day/guarantee.

changes.before: Yes. Separately from the phone plan, I want advice on making notifications reach the new address. I will ask staff when it takes effect too.
changes.after: Yes. Separately from the planned phone-number change, I want to ask about having notifications sent to the new address. I'll also ask the staff when that change takes effect.
changes.reason: Phone plan can mean subscription tariff; source means planned number change.

changes.before: Request a separate inquiry from the phone plan about notifications to the new address and effective timing. Say it in Japanese.
changes.after: In Japanese, ask separately from the planned phone-number change about sending notifications to the new address and when that takes effect.
changes.reason: Keep number-change plan, not mobile tariff plan.

changes.before: Có. Riêng với dự định điện thoại, muốn hỏi để thông báo đến địa chỉ mới. Cũng hỏi khi nào áp dụng.
changes.after: Có. Tách biệt với dự định đổi số điện thoại, tôi muốn hỏi về việc gửi thông báo đến địa chỉ mới. Tôi cũng sẽ hỏi người phụ trách khi nào thay đổi này có hiệu lực.
changes.reason: Address notification change is separate from number-change plan.

changes.before: Narito ang kondisyon sa pag-iimbak. Tiyaking hiwalay ang piraso at paraan ng pag-iimbak.
changes.after: Narito ang mga kondisyon sa pag-iimbak. Suriin natin nang magkahiwalay kung may mga piraso ng prutas at kung paano ito dapat itago.
changes.reason: Separate inquiries, not physically separate fruit pieces from storage method.

changes.before: อ่านว่าน้ำผลไม้เข้าใจ แต่แค่นั้นไม่รู้มีชิ้นเนื้อไหมค่ะ อยากตรวจเนื้อสัมผัสด้วย
changes.after: ฉันอ่านคำว่าน้ำผลไม้เข้าใจค่ะ แต่แค่นั้นยังไม่รู้ว่ามีชิ้นเนื้อผลไม้หรือไม่ อยากตรวจสอบเนื้อสัมผัสด้วย
changes.reason: Specify fruit flesh pieces rather than meat.

changes.before: อ่านน้ำผลไม้ได้แต่ไม่รู้ชิ้นเนื้อ อยากเช็กสัมผัส พูดเป็นภาษาญี่ปุ่น
changes.after: บอกเป็นภาษาญี่ปุ่นว่าอ่านคำว่าน้ำผลไม้ได้ แต่ยังไม่ทราบว่ามีชิ้นเนื้อผลไม้หรือไม่ และอยากตรวจสอบเนื้อสัมผัสด้วย
changes.reason: Hint needs fruit-piece referent.

changes.before: เงื่อนไขเก็บตรงนี้ครับ แยกตรวจชิ้นเนื้อกับอ่านวิธีเก็บ
changes.after: เงื่อนไขการเก็บอยู่ตรงนี้ครับ ควรตรวจสอบเรื่องมีชิ้นเนื้อผลไม้หรือไม่ แยกจากการอ่านวิธีเก็บรักษา
changes.reason: Keep fruit-pieces inquiry separate from storage reading.

changes.before: อยากหนึ่งมีชิ้นเนื้อครับ จะหาคำอธิบายยืนยันได้ วางเยลลี่ตรงนี้รอสักครู่
changes.after: คุณต้องการหนึ่งชิ้นที่มีเนื้อผลไม้เป็นชิ้น ๆ นะครับ เราจะหาคำอธิบายที่ตรวจสอบได้มาแจ้ง กรุณาวางเยลลี่ไว้ตรงนี้แล้วรอสักครู่ครับ
changes.reason: Requested pieces are fruit, not generic meat.

changes.before: I want a short circuit with a friend. I plan to choose this shortest line on the map.
changes.after: I want to walk a short loop with a friend. I plan to choose this shortest route on the map.
changes.reason: Avoid short circuit expression suggesting electricity; source means walking loop.

changes.before: Say you want a short circuit with a friend and plan to choose the map's shortest line. Say it in Japanese.
changes.after: In Japanese, say you want a short loop walk with a friend and plan to choose the shortest route shown on the map.
changes.reason: Natural short loop route rather than short circuit.

changes.before: Đường này cũng chỉ ứng viên, chưa quyết nhỉ. Tôi sẽ chia sẻ điều kiện có xe đẩy với bạn, muốn hỏi nhân viên cổng hướng dẫn hôm nay.
changes.after: Vậy đường này cũng chỉ là một phương án, chưa quyết định nhỉ. Tôi muốn cùng bạn thống nhất điều kiện có xe đẩy em bé và hỏi nhân viên ở cổng về hướng dẫn đi lại hôm nay.
changes.reason: Route candidate is an option, not human ứng viên.

changes.before: এটিও প্রার্থী, সিদ্ধান্ত নয়। বন্ধুকে শিশুর গাড়ির শর্ত জানিয়ে প্রবেশের কর্মীকে আজকের নির্দেশও জিজ্ঞেস করতে চাই।
changes.after: তাহলে এটিও কেবল একটি বিকল্প পথ, চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত নয়। বন্ধুর সঙ্গে শিশুর গাড়ি ব্যবহারের বিষয়টি মিলিয়ে নিয়ে প্রবেশপথের কর্মীকে আজকের চলাচলের নির্দেশনাও জিজ্ঞেস করতে চাই।
changes.reason: Route candidate should not be human candidate প্রার্থী.

changes.before: ค่ะ ไม่สัญญาก่อนว่าวนครบ เก็บตัวเลือกเดินแค่ส่วนที่ตรวจกับเพื่อน และตกลงทางกลับด้วยกันก่อนออก
changes.after: ค่ะ จะไม่สัญญาก่อนว่าเดินได้ครบรอบ และจะเก็บทางเลือกเดินเฉพาะส่วนที่ตรวจสอบกับเพื่อนแล้วไว้ด้วย เราจะตกลงประตูทางเข้าที่จะกลับไปด้วยกันก่อนออกเดินค่ะ
changes.reason: Retain return entrance, not only generic return way.

changes.before: ไม่สัญญาวนครบ เก็บเดินส่วนยืนยัน ตกลงทางกลับกับเพื่อนก่อนออก พูดเป็นภาษาญี่ปุ่น
changes.after: บอกเป็นภาษาญี่ปุ่นว่าจะไม่สัญญาว่าเดินได้ครบรอบ จะเก็บทางเลือกเดินเฉพาะส่วนที่ยืนยันแล้วไว้ และตกลงกับเพื่อนว่าจะกลับไปที่ประตูทางเข้าไหนก่อนออกเดิน
changes.reason: Hint must keep return entrance decision.

changes.before: Tôi không chọn chỉ vì rộng và không vào đây. Xin chỉ cổng vé hành khách và đường tránh thang từ đó.
changes.after: Tôi sẽ không chọn chỉ vì cửa rộng và không đi vào đây. Xin chỉ cổng soát vé dành cho hành khách và đường tránh cầu thang bộ từ đó.
changes.reason: Avoid stairs, not elevators; vague thang could contradict desired elevator route.

changes.before: Không chọn theo rộng, không vào cửa nhân viên, xin chỉ cổng hành khách và đường tránh thang. Hãy nói bằng tiếng Nhật.
changes.after: Hãy nói bằng tiếng Nhật rằng không chọn chỉ vì cửa rộng và không vào cửa dành cho nhân viên, rồi xin chỉ cổng soát vé hành khách và tuyến đường tránh cầu thang bộ.
changes.reason: Keep stair-avoidance distinct from elevator access.

changes.before: វេទិកាក្នុងណែនាំជិះនេះ។ អីវ៉ាន់ធំ ចង់សួរទ្វារធំជិតនេះទៅជណ្តើរយន្តបានទេ។
changes.after: ខ្ញុំចង់ទៅកន្លែងឡើងរថភ្លើងដែលបង្ហាញក្នុងសេចក្តីណែនាំជិះនេះ។ អីវ៉ាន់ខ្ញុំធំ ដូច្នេះខ្ញុំចង់សួរថាអាចទៅជណ្តើរយន្តតាមទ្វារទូលាយនៅជិតនេះបានទេ។
changes.reason: Clarify train platform rather than generic forum/stage word.

changes.before: មានអីវ៉ាន់ធំទៅវេទិកាកំណត់ សួរទ្វារទូលាយជិតនេះទៅជណ្តើរយន្តទេ។ និយាយជាភាសាជប៉ុន។
changes.after: មានអីវ៉ាន់ធំ ហើយចង់ទៅកន្លែងឡើងរថភ្លើងដែលបានបង្ហាញ សូមសួរថាអាចទៅជណ្តើរយន្តតាមទ្វារទូលាយនៅជិតនេះបានទេ។ និយាយជាភាសាជប៉ុន។
